messages:
Raj S.: FYI, at 09:12 UTC we saw EU-prod traffic being routed to us-east model variants during a fallback cascade. Console showed EU routing but infra logs say us-east variant selected.
Anna L.: Ugh. Did the region affinity check fail or did the fallback policy incorrectly mark variants as compatible?
Mike R.: I pulled the route decision trace: the policy engine returned candidate set with region=any after the quota gate tripped. Looks like service-tier override is missing.
Sophia T.: Can you paste the trace? specifically the part where `select_candidates()` returns the list.
Raj S.: snippet from trace:
```
policy.evaluate(request) -> {tier: "enterprise", region_pref: "eu-west-1", model_pin: null}
quota_gate.check -> TRIPPED(soft)
fallback.expand(region_relax=true)
select_candidates -> [gpt-x-us-east-v2, gpt-x-us-east-q4, gpt-x-eu-v1]
final_choice -> gpt-x-us-east-v2
```
Raj S.: Notice `fallback.expand` set region_relax=true — that's the odd bit.
Anna L.: That flag should only be set for public-tier during surge, not enterprise.
Mike R.: I think the bug is in the new quota gate scorer: it sets `allow_region_relax` when estimated latency < 200ms, ignoring customer_tier. Patch incoming.
deploy-bot: deploy started: policy-service@canary -> sha a1b2c3 (hotfix/region-relax-guard).
Ops-bot: Automated mitigation: injected temporary circuit-breaker to block cross-region fallback for customers with `tier=="enterprise"`.
Sophia T.: Good. We should also add a console flag to visualize `region_relax` decisions per-route. Right now it's buried in traces.
Anna L.: Agreed. Add a telemetry metric `policy.region_relax_decisions{tier,region}` and a per-route heatmap in the routes dashboard.
Mike R.: I'll open a quick PR for the metric + Grafana panel. Also adding unit tests verifying `quota_gate` respects `request.tier`.
Raj S.: Follow-ups: 1) rollback already rolled? (deploy-bot said canary) 2) run backfill to find other routes that saw `region_relax` true over last 24h, 3) postmortem draft.
deploy-bot: canary health: 2/2 healthy, policy-service hotfix promoted to stable.
Ops-bot: backfill query suggestion: `index=policy_traces | where region_relax==true and request.tier=="enterprise" | summarize count() by route,bin(1h)`
Anna L.: I'll start the postmortem outline. Short-term action: add a config guard in console UX to prevent enabling regional relaxation globally without per-tier whitelist.
Mike R.: On it. PR: github.com/redwood/policy-service/pull/4247 -> contains guard + tests + telemetry.
Sophia T.: Thank you all. Lesson: fallback heuristics are powerful but must be combined with explicit tier constraints in both policy code and UX. :+1:
Raj S.: Closing thread once postmortem link is up. Thanks for quick turnaround!
